verdict.rationale: Anti-bot proxy rotation is a fair question for a web-scraping service, but nothing in the evidence documents automatic retry across a chain of different proxies when a request is blocked. The only related item is a general reliability claim of "no proxy headaches" (firecrawl-gh-8), which describes no proxy-fallback or retry mechanism. A community comment also says Firecrawl lacks a proxy service, so there is no documented capability to credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically retry through a chain of different proxies when anti-bot detection blocks a request
